images.caption: First Pizza Hut building at Wichita State University Campus, Kansas. It was opened at the corner of Kellogg and Bluff on June 15, 1958 by brothers Frank and Dan Carney, who were attending the University at the time. The building was moved to the WSU campus to serve as a symbol and reminder to WSU students that young individuals, through hard work and initiative, can rise from modest beginnings to positions of leadership and success.
